basic_info.description: Modern Comfort in the Heart of Ingleside. Nestled in the vibrant Ingleside district, just blocks from Ocean Avenue, this refined single-family home offers the perfect blend of modern comfort and urban convenience. Thoughtfully updated and meticulously maintained, the home boasts beautifully curated living spaces designed to elevate everyday living. The main level features 4 spacious bedrooms and 2 bathrooms with a beautifully remodeled bathroom. An open-concept living and dining area is both warm and welcoming, enhanced by modern finishes, abundant natural light, and wide-plank flooring throughout. The custom kitchen is a true standout with an open concept. The lower level offers incredible flexibility, featuring 3 additional bedrooms, 1.5 bathrooms, and a cozy living area ideal for extended family, guests, or potential rental income. Included 1-car garage, Ample storage space & generously sized backyard, perfect for outdoor entertaining, gardening, or relaxing in your private oasis. Conveniently located minutes from Whole Foods, 24 Hour Fitness, Ocean Avenue shops and restaurants, City College, and offering easy access to BART, Muni, and major freeways- this home delivers the best of residential living with unmatched urban accessibility.
